title: mail-server: email_pushes_for core (gates, filter, projection without implicit id, state, urgency)
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E8. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: M.

Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §3 (EmailPush object, state "after all of the Emails"), §4 (sent regardless of types; MUST NOT send before verification; properties like Email/get but no implicit id, empty list => {}; urgency). jmapio/jmap#474. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §5.3; decisions 10 and 20.

In emailpush/deliver.rs define #[non_exhaustive] DeliveredEmail { email: &Email (post-Sieve), thread_keywords }, EmailPushBatch { account_id, account: &EmailPushAccount (live), emails, state, max_bytes }, OutboundEmailPush { push, urgency } and pub fn email_pushes_for(&StoredPushSubscription, now_secs, &EmailPushBatch) -> Result<Vec<OutboundEmailPush>, EmailPushError>. Returns [] when jmap_server::is_deliverable is false (unverified/expired), keys is None, emailPush has no entry for account_id, or nothing matches. It ignores `types`. It filters with filter::email_matches, then projects each match with project::project_email(email, &cfg.properties) in no-implicit-id mode (id only when listed; [] => {}; objectHistory never emitted, even from a config that bypassed validation, decision 10). state is emitted as null when !account.mail. urgency comes from the config. Keep DeliveredEmail wrapping &jmap_mail_types::Email (public Email::new; decision 20). Its rustdoc, and the EmailPushBackend consumer MUSTs, state that an IMAP-only deployment without ObjectID (RFC 8474), which has no JMAP id/blobId/threadId/mailboxIds, fills those four required fields with any valid placeholder; validation rejects those properties and inMailbox/inMailboxOtherThan for such accounts (mail: false, object_ids: false), so a placeholder is never emitted or matched (decision 20). In this bead all matches go into ONE EmailPush; size limits and splitting come in JMAP-r44n.2 (leave a TODO naming that bead).
Acceptance: the §5 delivery yields exactly the spec's EmailPush figure (id M699bb151ca4cbf1c24364a68) from hand-written JSON; properties [] => [{}]; ["from"] => no id; an unverified, expired or keyless subscription gets nothing; types: [] still gets EmailPush; state null when mail:false even if the caller passes one; urgency carried to OutboundEmailPush; a stored config containing objectHistory projects the other names in order without it; for an account with mail:false, object_ids:false, a DeliveredEmail built with placeholder id/blobId/threadId/mailboxIds never shows them in any EmailPush (decision 20).
